seo.title: Canteen at IGCH, Kochi | Meals & Refreshments on Campus
seo.description: The canteen at Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH), Kadavanthra, Kochi serves meals, snacks and refreshments for patients' families, bystanders, visitors and hospital staff.

hero.lead: The canteen at Indira Gandhi Co-operative Hospital (IGCH) serves meals, snacks and refreshments for patients' families, bystanders, visitors and hospital staff.

cards.title: Patients' families and bystanders
paragraphs: Convenient access to meals while accompanying patients.

cards.title: Visitors
paragraphs: Food and refreshments during hospital visits.

cards.title: Hospital staff
paragraphs: Meals and refreshments during working hours.

sections.heading: Food hygiene
paragraphs: We maintain attention to cleanliness, food handling and preparation practices to provide a hygienic dining environment.

sections.heading: A Note for Patients
paragraphs: Patients following a prescribed diet should consult their treating doctor or dietitian before purchasing food from the canteen. Dietary requirements may vary depending on the patient's medical condition and treatment plan.
